title: Cafe Lucetti: The First Pour
brief: For people who start early. Feeling: the quiet before the city wakes belongs to you. Fact: Cafe Lucetti is open before the city wakes. 45 s, 2.39:1, calm narrator.

promise.text: One person, one café, one morning. Every shot moves. No text in shot, the brand only on the end card. Warm amber light against blue dawn.

concepts.title: The First Pour
concepts.logline: Lena opens her café in the dark, and the first cup of the day turns the street from blue to gold.
concepts.hook: One lit window on a dark street.
concepts.image: Steam rising through the first ray of sun.
concepts.fit: Light, steam and one person: what video models draw best.

concepts.title: Closing Time Regulars
concepts.logline: Three regulars who never meet share the same table at different hours.
concepts.hook: A cup ring on a wooden table.
concepts.image: Three cups appearing in a time-lapse.

concepts.title: The Grinder
concepts.logline: The sound of the grinder wakes the whole street, window by window.
concepts.fit: Wides with light changes, no people walking.

rows.subject: one lit café window
rows.subject_motion: the warm light flickers on behind the glass
rows.scene: a dark street at 5:30 am, wet cobbles, blue dawn
rows.intent: someone is up before everyone else
rows.vo: At half past five, the street still belongs to the night.

rows.subject: Lena
rows.subject_motion: ties her apron and breathes in
rows.scene: the café behind the counter, one pendant lamp on
rows.vo: Lena likes it that way. One lamp, one apron, one deep breath.

rows.subject: the espresso machine
rows.subject_motion: the first shot of coffee pours into a cup
rows.scene: the counter, steam in the lamplight
rows.intent: the first cup of the day
rows.vo: The first pour is always hers.

rows.subject: Lena
rows.subject_motion: carries the cup to the window table
rows.scene: the empty café, blue light through the window
rows.vo: She carries it to the window and sits for one minute.

rows.subject: the steam from the cup
rows.subject_motion: rises and catches the first ray of sun
rows.scene: the window table, the street turning gold
rows.intent: the day arrives through her cup
rows.vo: Then the sun finds the steam, and the street turns gold.

rows.subject: Tom
rows.subject_motion: pushes the door open and walks to the counter
rows.scene: the café in gold morning light
rows.vo: At six, Tom arrives. He never has to order.

rows.subject: Lena
rows.subject_motion: slides a cup across the counter and smiles
rows.vo: Some mornings start with a sunrise. Ours start with a cup.

rows.subject: the end card
rows.onscreen_text: Cafe Lucetti. The first pour is yours.
rows.vo: Cafe Lucetti. The first pour is yours.

looks.Lena: a woman in her early thirties, fair skin with light freckles, dark blond hair in a low bun, rust-colored linen apron over a cream sweater
looks.Tom: a man in his sixties, light tan skin, short grey beard, navy wool coat and a flat cap

style: Cinematic film still, 35 mm anamorphic lens, soft motivated light, gentle film grain, shallow depth of field, photoreal, 16:9.

music.style: warm solo piano and soft strings, slow, hopeful, gentle build, 72 bpm
music.title: First Pour
